entities.summary: VIZJA University, until May 2025 the University of Economics and Human Sciences in Warsaw, is a private university based in Warsaw, Poland. VIZJA specializes in the fields of finance and management, social sciences, and human sciences, but also offers degrees in medical sciences and the arts. The university is renowned for its courses in Psychology, recommended by the Polish Academy of Sciences, and the university's School of Business has CEEMAN International Quality Accreditation. University of Finance and Management In Warsaw is a university in Europe, established in 2001. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Established in 2001, VIZJA University has contributed to Poland's higher education landscape with its specialized programs in finance and management. Its CEEMAN International Quality Accreditation has set a standard for business education in Eastern Europe.
